# opnsense_trust_cert_by_description (Data Source)

Looks up exactly one existing OPNsense Trust certificate by its stable description and returns only local metadata needed to reference it. Certificate/key material is intentionally not exposed in Terraform state.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `description` (String) Exact certificate description. Leading/trailing whitespace is ignored for the lookup input, but matching is case-sensitive.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Local OPNsense certificate UUID.
- `ref_id` (String) Local OPNsense certificate refid used by HAProxy and other subsystems.
